runtime: macOS 27.0 ARM64, CPython 3.14.5; observed before candidate execution
execution_boundary: No GUI, model, network, application runtime, OS input, game, or effect dispatch. No container image required by this finite standard-library method test.
input: input/fixture.json; 8 fixed training seeds 100-107, 24 disjoint held-out seeds 200-223, fixed deterministic noise, one scalar plant, and nine boundary probes
invocation_rule: One candidate invocation and one independent raw-only auditor invocation. No scientific reruns.
decision_gate: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if exact candidate updates match the independent oracle on all training states; all 5 seeded mutation controls are rejected; reset, generation, residual freshness, terminal, release, safety, action-bound, and trust-region gates hold; and held-out median pre-correction absolute error and median correction actions both improve over fixed control with zero hard-gate regression. FAIL_METHOD on any update mismatch or hard-gate regression. NO_DISCRIMINATION if the preregistered held-out objectives do not improve.
scope: Synthetic finite scalar-control method result only; no real GUI, control convergence, task success, safety, or product claim.
